title: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

sense.text:
This is a follow-up to last week’s class, under a whole new name with new scriptures. “Master, which is the great commandment in the law?” Christ answers, “Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the first and great commandment.”

Christ is quoting two laws that are not written in the ten commandments. Not specifically: the spirit is there, but technically it’s not written there. The first four of the ten are summed up in Deuteronomy 6:5.
“And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.” That law, from Leviticus 19:18, sums up the last six of the ten commandments.

“On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.” All the laws are based upon those two, and everything the prophets prophesied about is based upon those two: loving the Lord your God with all your heart, mind and soul, and loving your neighbour as yourself. All the prophecies in the Bible are based upon those two things.

precepts.why: “Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it”. Read verse one, then jump to five: all the commandments are summed up there.

“And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.” This is where Christ is quoting from in Matthew 22. The first four of the ten commandments are summed up in it.

“Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.” This is the second great commandment Christ quotes, and that law sums up the last six of the ten commandments.

sense.text:
“Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise; For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.” David is prophesying in terms of Christ, but it also translates to us, and that shows as we keep going down the psalm.

The lying tongue is what they said in Luke 23: that Christ was perverting the nation. And his teachings were called heresy. Don’t they say that about us today? It’s the same thing going on.

precepts.why: “And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate. And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.” That is the mouth of the wicked and the deceitful opened against him, speaking with a lying tongue: they said Christ was perverting the nation.

“But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy”. So the teachings of Christ were called a heresy. So don’t feel upset when they say you’re in a cult. Don’t feel no way, because they said Christ perverted the nation and his teachings were heresy. They say the same about us today.

sense.text: “They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.” They wanted to stone Christ for his good works.

precepts.why: “Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me? The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.” They fought against him without a cause: they wanted to stone Christ.

sense.text: “For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.” For my love they are my enemies. And those adversaries were his own people.

precepts.why:
“And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?” She couldn’t even stand up straight; she was bound.

“And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.” It calls them his adversaries, and they were his own people. For his love they were his adversaries.

sense.text: “And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.” Our people rewarded Christ evil for good and hatred for his love. These are scriptural examples of it.

precepts.why: “But his citizens hated him”: the citizens of Jerusalem hated the son of God, “and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.” The wicked scribes and Pharisees, the leadership, did not want Christ to rule over them.
“Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him”. They bound him with wire, with cords, with rope. That is evil for good.

“But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.” We have no king but the white man: that’s what they said. Today we call it a president; Caesar is a president. Caesar is also pronounced Kaiser, Khazar: it’s the same word.

sense.text:
“Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.” There’s some dark stuff right there. It starts off talking about the wicked Israelites of our people who didn’t want Christ to reign over them. They said, “We have no king but Cesar”: we wanted the white man over us. And the Bible says here, set thou a wicked man over him, and let Satan stand at his right hand.

The mystery behind it goes back to Genesis 4: Satan ruling over Cain. After the flood, through Shem’s line you had Jacob and Esau, to sum it up, and Esau came out with no melanin.

Even back then the spiritual demon Satan was operating with Rome. How do you think Rome was able to conquer everybody? Rome was the most powerful kingdom on the planet earth at that time, and Satan was working with Rome just like he’s working with America. And our people, the scribes and Pharisees, loved Rome and feared Rome; they wanted Rome to be our king.

Satan has children on the earth, and the wicked man set over us is the children of the devil.

precepts.why: Go back to what was just read: “But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.” We wanted the white man over us. And the Bible says, “Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.”
“The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.” They were so concerned with Herod; they were enamored with Herod.

“Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles. If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.” We were so in fear of Rome and in love with Rome: we both feared them and loved them at the same time. And that’s how it is with our people today.

This is the mystery behind Satan standing at his right hand. “And the Lord said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth?” What you mad for, Cain? Why you upset? “And why is thy countenance fallen?” Why your face look all sad and depressed like that?

“If thou doest well”, meaning if you are obedient to what I command, “shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well”, if you don’t do the commandments I’ve given, “sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire”: Cain’s desire would be to Satan. Just as God told Eve her desire would be to her husband, anything Cain desired, knowledge, wisdom, understanding, rulership, he’d have to get from Satan. “And thou shalt rule over him”: thou, Satan, shall rule over him. Just like God said to the man, you shall rule over her, Satan rules over Cain. And this is before the flood. This Cain became the white man.

“And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.” He killed his brother. They all looked the same at this time. “And the Lord said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?” Remember the two great commandments in Matthew 22: they start out in the Bible right here.

“And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.” Abel was alive in the spirit realm; that’s why his voice was crying unto the Lord.

“And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand”. Adam was made of the dust of the ground, a black man made of the soil. Cain was cursed from the earth: his melanin left him and he started to change. The Most High said, I made you from it, and you’re cursed from it.

“Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow”, because our sisters, our women, our wife was rebellious; Eve was rebellious. “And thy conception”: so they would have childbearing pains, menstrual cramps. “In sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband”. If you desire sex, knowledge or wisdom, you must get it from your husband: anything you desire, God said to Eve, get it from your man.

That explains Genesis 4:7. The same wording is said to Cain, “unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him”: as the man rules over the woman, Satan rules over Cain, and anything Cain desires he gets from Satan.

“And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground”. So Adam was a black man, made of the soil, made of the earth. Then Cain is “cursed from the earth”: his melanin left him. He was made from the earth and cursed from it.

“Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders”. He follows Satan; Satan rules him. Satan is ruling over this man of sin, and this is the same curse from Genesis 4:7, “unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.”

Where do you think this man got his technology from? Satan. He desired knowledge, he desired wisdom, and he got all that: how to create an atom bomb, how to create chemical bombs, how to destroy the earth. Satan said, I got you.

“In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil”. So God has children on the earth, and Satan got kids on earth too. The church ain’t figured that out yet; they’re looking around the sky. “Whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God”: whosoever does not keep the commandments is not of God, “neither he that loveth not his brother.”

This is why it’s important for us to teach love thy neighbour as you love yourself to our people. Some at home are asking why that can’t be extended to the white man. It’s been over 500 years of us trying to talk to the white man, and it has not worked. A negro came out his mama’s behind yesterday talking about, why can’t we sit down and talk to the white man? Our ancestors had that same stupid thought back during slavery time. It didn’t work then, and it ain’t working now.

This is for the Christians online who think we can sit down at the table. Malcolm X said if we can sit down with the white man at a table and talk man to man, honestly, maybe he’ll listen. That’s not what God said.

“The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.” “Their poison is like the poison of a serpent”: their philosophies, their doctrines are like the poison of snakes. “They are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear”. You’re busy talking, and God says the white man is like a deaf snake that stops her ears. The adder ain’t got no ears. Look at the snake: it ain’t got no ears, and you’re trying to reason with him.

“Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.” You black Christians are the charmers. Charming never so wisely means you come with all your wisdom, historic evidence and proof of why we deserve reparations, why we deserve justice, and the white man looks at you with that fake smile like, what is this? We have some of the most eloquent, intellectual speakers in the black community: Malcolm X was one of the best, and it didn’t work on the white man. You got your Umar Johnsons out there, bringing out evidence, bam, bam, bam. Nothing works on the white man.

God has one solution for the white man: “Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Lord.” That’s God’s solution: God the Lord is going to do that thing.

sense.text: This is talking about the white man. “For thou hast said in thine heart”: this is what the white man says. “I will ascend into heaven”: this Lucifer is the white man. “I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”: that’s space travel; they landed on the moon. “I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation”: the congregation is Israel, so he sits upon the mount of the congregation of the Israelites, “in the sides of the north”: North America.
“I will ascend above the heights of the clouds”: their planes, their jets, their helicopters. “I will be like the most High”: they said, I will be like God.
“Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.” God said, yet I’m going to bring you down to hell, the lowest part.

“They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms”. This is the part to stress in your teachings, brothers, because Christians will say Lucifer is a spirit in the sky. No: they that see Lucifer shall look upon him and say, is this the man. The man that made the earth tremble and shook kingdoms with their bombs and war destruction. Lucifer is man on earth. Lucifer is the children of the devil we read about in 1 John 3:10.

You might say Israelites will fall under that too. Yes: when our people follow behind them, they are the children of the devil. They gave their love, their heart, their soul to Rome. That’s why Christ said to them, you are of your father the devil, because they were following Rome. That goes with our people today: I love democracy, I love Republicans, I love the liberals. Shut up. You’re the child of the devil.

Verse 20 shows that Satan, the devil, got kids on earth. “Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land”: this white man has destroyed his land, “and slain thy people”.

“The seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.” The seed of evildoers means there are generations of children. Renowned means known or talked about by many people: famous. Who’s the most famous people on earth? The white man. Esau: you don’t get no more famous than him. Think about medicine, science, education: you think about the white man, not anything Chinese, Japanese, black or Hispanic. Right now we hold them up in fame and glory, and God said you will never be renowned again.

One other way you know Esau, the children of the devil, is renowned: he can propagate a lie and it’s known all over the planet. There is no Bible that describes Christ as a white man, not a scripture anywhere that confirms that image, yet everywhere on the planet people will say that so-called Caucasian image is Jesus, damn near your unborn kids included. That’s how deep the damn demons go.

So the Bible calls them the seed of evildoers: the ones with the tiki torch, the KKK type of thing from the Inquisition. They are in law enforcement. They are in the medical field, in politics where you just want to vote, vote, vote, and in the lobbyists. Even in religion: I thought they were teaching us the good news of Jesus. This is the seed of evildoers.

precepts.why: “All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.” The congregation is Israel. So when the white man says “I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”, he sits upon the mount of the Israelites in North America.

sense.text:
“When he shall be judged, let him be condemned”. There’s no salvation, no forgiveness for him. He’s going to be in the kingdom, don’t misunderstand; he’ll be there, but he’s not going to enjoy it. I don’t know why you think you can oppress people, colonize people, enslave people, murder people, and think you’re going to get the kingdom of heaven on earth, you and your children. It makes no logical sense.

“And let his prayer become sin.” He turned his ear away from the law, so even his prayer is abomination.

precepts.why:
“Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.” This man sold his birthright.

“For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected”: God rejected this man. “For he found no place of repentance”: God says there’s no place of repentance for him. But what if he cries? “Though he sought it carefully with tears”: God didn’t care about it. That is “When he shall be judged, let him be condemned”.

“He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.” The white man turned his ear away from the law from the time of his birthright; he rejected everything God had for him. So his prayer becomes sin.

sense.text: “Let his days be few; and let another take his office.” We got next, brothers. We’re going to take his office.
“Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.”
“Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.” A vagabond is a bum, and it all goes back to the beginning, to the curse on Cain.

precepts.why: “For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.” Let his days be few and let another take his office: we got next.

It all goes back to the beginning. “When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.” A vagabond: a bum. That’s some heavy stuff right there. No getting out, you white man.

“The inheritance of sinners’ children shall perish”. This is the man that steals lands and property, homes and houses, and then passes it down to his children. “And their posterity shall have a perpetual reproach”: they’re always going to have a reproach.

“The children will complain of an ungodly father”: it wasn’t me, it was my forefathers; we didn’t enslave you, it was my fathers. “Because they shall be reproached for his sake.” We all say it to them today, and they say it wasn’t me, it was my father, I just benefit from it. Yeah, you. That’s what’s going on now: no accountability, zero responsibility, and an enormous amount of self-entitlement.

sense.text: “Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.” Everything they stole and passed down to their kids is going to be handed over to us.

precepts.why: “His children shall seek to please the poor”. We’re the poor. “And his hands shall restore their goods.” Everybody talks about reparations. God said don’t worry: we’re going to get our just reparations, because everything that they stole and passed down to their kids is going to be handed over to us.

“That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down”: he ain’t going to enjoy it. “According to his substance shall the restitution be”: according to all that he has robbed and stolen. Restitution means reparations. “And he shall not rejoice therein”: that’s why he ain’t going to be happy in this thing.

“Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor”: we’re the poor. “Because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not”. He violently took away everything he got. We built it and he stole it.

sense.text: “Let there be none to extend mercy unto him”: nobody’s going to extend mercy to this man. “Neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.” Isaiah 13 is the precept for letting none show favour to his fatherless children.

precepts.why:
“Every one that is found shall be thrust through”: every Edomite in Babylon, throughout the world, that is found. “And every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword”: any of our people, any of the other nations joined to Esau.

“Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes”: that’s let none show favour to their children. “Their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.” That’s what the nations are going to do to them.

“Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them”: the Medes here is Iran. Write that down. “Which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it”: Iran doesn’t care about money and has no delight in silver and gold; they got that already. “Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces”: their bows are their missiles. Armageddon is coming, brothers. It will happen; thus saith the Lord. “And they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.”

“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms”: the United States of America, the most glorious kingdom on earth right now. “The beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah with thermonuclear fire, and that’s how this place is going to go down. That’s Bible prophecy.

sense.text: “Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.” Their name shall be blotted out.

“Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.” You do pay for what your fathers did, because you are your fathers. It goes all the way back to Genesis: Cain killed his brother, and the law is whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed. Cain was worried that everyone finding him would slay him, and Cain’s children is Esau today. Now it’s time for him to get his judgment: the Most High is going to bring that law all the way back and allow the nations to slay him.

“Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.” God said he’s going to cut off the memory of them from the earth. Get mad if you want; it’s what the Lord said.

precepts.why:
“Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers”: that’s what God says. For the sins of their fathers: you do pay for what your fathers did, because you are your fathers, and it goes all the way back to Cain and Abel.

“That they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.” They’ll never build another city. That’s what the Bible says. Don’t get mad at us, don’t hate the messenger: you’ve never heard what the Bible says, and now we’re bringing it out.

Christ said the righteous blood of Abel shall fall upon them, which shows it is absolutely correct that the iniquity goes all the way back to Abel. “That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.”

He’s talking to our people. He said, y’all are so wicked you ain’t following in the footsteps of Abel; you’re following the footsteps of Cain. Therefore the judgment for the blood shed on Abel will be paid on you. Because the Pharisees did the bidding of Rome: they wanted to please Herod and Caesar, and thought if they killed Christ and his disciples they would please them. That’s the same thing with some of our people in the Christian church today.

“And the Lord said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book”: write this for a memorial in the book, the Bible, “and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.” Who’s Amalek? These so-called Jewish people. That is cutting off the memory of them from the earth.

“And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it.” Who spoke that? The Lord spoke that thing, so we can’t change it. The Lord don’t care about our feelings: he said there’s going to be none remaining.

Somebody online is going, but you read about Amalek and Esau, and that’s two different groups. No: it’s the same race. “These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau”, and among them “duke Amalek”. So Amalek was a grandson of Esau. It’s the same family.

The dukes were the elites of them: the rich, the smarter ones, the more clever, crafty, cunning and wealthy. The synagogue of Satan. Netanyahu is one of their dukes. And to show how deep the witchcraft goes, they ask you when the atrocities in Gaza started, and you jump to say October 7th. No: that over there didn’t start October 7th. That began in 1948.

A Caucasian, an Edomite, Michael Bradley, found out some history and wrote it down in Chosen People from the Caucasus. Poorly informed blacks think of the Jews as people of the book and look more favourably on them than on other Caucasians, not knowing the Jews of Europe played the same role in our enslavement, oppression and colonization as other Europeans. He writes that most of them are descendants of Russian steppe tribesmen converted to Judaism around 740 AD, the Khazars, a fact Jewish scholars admit; that Jews were well represented among the conquistadors who murdered and enslaved the Indians and were major participants in the transatlantic slave trade, the greatest human tragedy history knows; and that 95% of the Jews in the modern world are Ashkenazim, with no genetic or historical connection with Palestine, so their claim to a homeland there is absurd. The white man wrote this. The devil deceiveth the whole world, and that’s what this author is bringing out.

sense.text:
“Because that he remembered not to shew mercy”: this white man remembered not to show our people mercy, “but persecuted the poor and needy man”. Somebody right now is saying white people are poor and Chinese people are poor; that’s not who it’s talking about. The poor are Zion, our people, not all nations on the planet. “That he might even slay the broken in heart.” The broken in heart are Jerusalem and Zion: our people.

That’s what the Bible means when it says they showed us no mercy. They used to gather the tribe of Gad and Reuben and hang them up by thirteens, representing Christ and the apostles, and burn them alive with the fire under them, and take our babies and smash them on the rocks. They cut the people open to get the babies out, split them in two. They did it to the men too: took our entrails out and fed us to the dogs. These are drawings they did between 1492 and the 1500s. They cut the hands off if they didn’t bring back enough gold, and cut off the hands and noses. They impaled a family, the father on the left, the mother on the right and the baby in the middle, a spike through the rectum, and threw us into pits with spikes in them, pregnant and nursing women, children and old persons. Did they do the same thing in the Congo? Same thing, different dates, the same people.

They tied a little boy to a tree as gator bait to bring the gator on land, and sometimes they let the gator swallow the baby. They even put it on cans of licorice: our baby about to be eaten by an alligator was the logo. And Derby’s dose on the Jamaican plantations: beaten, salt pickle, lime juice and pepper rubbed into the wounds, another slave made to defecate in the victim’s mouth, and the mouth shut for hours. That’s what they did to us.

The churches will never illustrate what the Bible is talking about, but we will, because we’re the prophets of God. Bring it all the way up from slavery to today: the people in those pictures have children grown today, sitting as your judges and the teachers in your school, and you want to know why she treats your child so bad? She was taught that. Look at all the names of our people killed. And y’all want to sit down and seek justice from this man who has shown us no mercy from the time of slavery to today, while men and women on the street say go out and vote. If our people think they can sit down at the table and talk to this man, that ain’t going to work.

“As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.” The first thought when you read about cursing is profanity, the hell with you. This is deeper than that: the cursing is a literal spell.

You ever ask yourself why there is so much hatred amongst our people? It’s as if a spell is on us. There is. Television, the internet, radio, the newsroom put messages out there that cause us to hate one another, hate our children, abort our children. That is a spell. You don’t see no other race doing it the way black men and black women and Latin men and Latin women do this. And the only spell breaker is the word of God.

Kamala Harris sat down with a rapper named Quavo and asked him his solutions for gun violence. Doesn’t he rap about evil, harming people? And you’re asking him for a solution? The only solution is us repenting as Israelites, keeping the commandments. There is no other way.

precepts.why: To prove who the poor are. “What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.” The poor of his people of Zion. Now that we’ve established Zion is the poor, the poor and needy man of Psalms 109:16 is not referring to all nations on the planet.

“Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.” America is called the lady of kingdoms, the greatest kingdom on earth.

“I was wroth with my people”: God was mad with us. “I have polluted mine inheritance”: he allowed us to get polluted here in this land, this kingdom, “and given them into thine hand”: God gave us into the hands of the white man because of our sins. “Thou didst shew them no mercy”: this white man showed us no mercy. “Upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.” Verse six says the same thing as Psalms 109:16: this man showed us no mercy but persecuted the poor and needy.

“He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.” We want to know who the broken in heart is, the ones the wicked man of Psalms 109:16 seeks to slay. Verse 12 shows who it’s talking about.

“Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.” O Jerusalem: that’s our people. We’re Jerusalem; Jerusalem is a people before it’s a place. O Zion: that’s our people. So the broken in heart he heals, and the broken in heart the white man slays, are our people.

“And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.” That curse is not profanity. That curse is a literal spell he was asking him to do. That is the cursing the white man loves in Psalms 109:17.

“Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob”: when you keep the commandments, the spell breaks, “neither is there any divination against Israel”. We must keep the commandments; that is the solution. The only spell breaker is the word of God.

“For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.” The cursing and the lies. These people lie to get world sympathy: Donald Trump suggesting Jews might secretly be committing antisemitic hate crimes on themselves; a New York man arrested for painting swastikas on his own home; an Israeli man indicted for threats to Jewish community centers; the Anti-Defamation League conveying false information and cyberstalking; an antisemitic hate crime at a Winnipeg cafe allegedly faked by the owners; a man who told police he was stabbed for being Jewish until his Apple Watch caught him in a lie; a false report of an antisemitic incident on a school bus; a London mayor helping the Israel lobby fake antisemitic attacks; a singer who admitted he lied about antisemitic incidents.

They always want to play victim and then say a black man did it, so they get world sympathy. This is all from newspapers; nothing conjured. Stop lying. Why you always lying?

sense.text:
There are three angels in this chapter, and they teach, or bring forth through the prophets, three messages in these last days. The first is the angel flying “in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel”.

First understand the word gospel. Write this down: it means good news, good tidings. Tidings means news. Good news.

When we are preaching the gospel, there is an angel in the midst preaching the everlasting gospel through us. You think it’s you; it ain’t you. The Lord has an angel there preaching through the brothers. Y’all got to understand that.

“To every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people”: that ain’t talking about all nations on the earth. It is the twelve tribes scattered abroad.

“Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him”: that means we are teaching God’s commandments. That’s how you fear God. When we say fear God and give glory to him, we’re telling the people, keep the commandments. Keeping God’s commandments is the beginning of fear.

“For the hour of his judgment is come”: we got to let our people know the hour of judgment is come.

“And worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters”: him, not Allah, not Buddha, not white Jesus.

“And there followed another angel”: this is the second angel, “saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.” The first angel preaches the everlasting gospel. The next angel comes and preaches through the brothers that Babylon is falling. That’s destruction. That was the spirit in all the prophets, all the preachers.

So the first angel came and prophesied through the prophets: worship God, keep the commandments. The second angel comes through us and says, prophesy the fall of Babylon. Now we get to the third angel.

“And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast”: that’s the white man, by the way, “and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand”.

“The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb”: in the presence of Christ.

What we’re reading is exactly what Thessalonians said. Paul just used different words; John used harder words. But it’s all saying the same thing. You got to be able to sit down, compare the two and say, this is about the same thing.

“And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.” That last angel is what we are going to be preaching and teaching: torment is coming for the rebellious Israelites.

If you want to escape that, like we do, read the next verse. “Here is the patience of the saints”: the twelve tribes of Israel. “Here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

precepts.why:
“O Zion, that bringest good tidings”: O Zion that bringeth the gospel. That’s what the everlasting gospel is talking about. “Get thee up into the high mountain”. “O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings”: O Jerusalem that bringeth the gospel.

“Lift up thy voice with strength”: brothers, we are to lift up our voice with strength. “Lift it up, be not afraid”: brothers, we cannot afford to be afraid. “Say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!”

“Behold, the Lord God will come”: as we are preaching the gospel, the Lord will come, “with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him”: Christ shall rule for him. “Behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.”

“How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings”. The mountains are the governments, the kingdoms. So how many of you men do not have a passport? Tell the truth. A lot of hands went up. How y’all going to get to these mountains, which represent governments, and teach the good news? Waiting for somebody else to do it? We going to fix it.

“That publisheth peace”: the teaching goes into preaching, but it also deals with publishing publications. The literature the brothers hand out, the art department, the literature published in various languages. The diaspora brothers that speak various languages play a big part in this.

“That bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!” That is what we say to Zion.

“Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice”: you men are the watchmen. You don’t just lift it up here in Atlanta, in your respective cities, your respective states. “With the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye”. It’s not just in America.

“The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me”: the Lord anointed Christ, and he has anointed us the same way, “to preach good tidings unto the meek”: to preach the gospel unto the meek. “He hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound”.

“To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord”: our job is to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, “and the day of vengeance of our God”. We got to proclaim the day of vengeance is coming from our God.

“To comfort all that mourn”: so preaching vengeance comforts all that mourn. That vengeance got to be part of the gospel.

Our people need good news. “As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.”

There are quite a few in the class who come from outside the United States, from Jamaica, Haiti and other places. You’re learning this truth here. It would behoove you to take what you’ve learned and go back, even for a week or two, and teach maybe a month or two. You ain’t got to stay back; we’ll bring you back. We ain’t going to leave you on your own.

So how many young men travel with a purpose? And asking about a passport is not talking about passport bros. We brothers travel with a purpose, a divine purpose: to teach the glad tidings, the good news, the gospel, to our brothers and sisters, our sons and daughters scattered worldwide. The rest of our people that travel, they travel for booty, for sex; they have no purpose in life. Write this down: a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single repentant step. And we’re going to travel thousands of miles to reach our brothers and sisters.

“How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard?” We want our people to cry to the one true God, but they have not heard about the one true God who’s coming with vengeance. They’ve heard about a lily white Edomite coming from the sky bringing peace to all mankind.

“And how shall they hear without a preacher?” Preacher means prophet. “And how shall they preach, except they be sent?” Our job is to send you, brothers. You must understand the mission you’re in. God commissions us to send you; God is sending all of us.

“How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!” That’s our job.

The angel has the gospel to preach “to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people”. James writes “to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad”. So it ain’t talking about all nations on the earth. The nations and kindreds and tongues are the twelve tribes scattered abroad.

“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments”. So when the angel says “Fear God, and give glory to him”, we’re telling the people, keep the commandments. Keeping God’s commandments is how you fear God.

To fear God, there’s a lot in there. Christ gave us the two great commandments: “Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the first and great commandment. And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.”

The love of God and the love of your neighbor, your brother. In another word: your love of God and race create a foundation of identity, unity, faith, and confidence that will inspire others worldwide. It’s a big job, brothers, but you’ve been called.

Those two great commandments comprise the Ten Commandments, and more than just those ten; the ten are a template for all the commandments. The first four deal with our relationship with the Most High, how to love and worship the Lord: have no other gods before me; make no graven image to bow down and worship; take not the name of the Lord your God in vain; remember the Sabbath day to keep it holy. The next six deal with your neighbor: honor your father and mother; thou shalt not kill; thou shalt not commit adultery; thou shalt not steal; don’t bear false witness; thou shalt not covet.

On these two hang all the law and the prophets, because everything the prophets prophesied about pertains to God’s laws.

“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” That’s what the second angel was doing, crying Babylon is fallen, because that was the spirit in all the prophets, all the preachers.

The third angel speaks of men that “receive his mark in his forehead”. Job shows what marks a man: “If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.” The mark comes by sin.

sense.text: Christ read the same thing we just read in Isaiah 61. “And, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.” Christ stood up to read on the Sabbath day.
“And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written”: that’s what we just read. He’s going to quote Isaiah 61:1.

“The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor”. You men got to realize the same anointing that Christ had is on each and every one of us. We’ve been given a divine mission: our job is to preach the gospel to the poor of our people.

Then each one: “to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised”. The poor, the brokenhearted, the captives, the blind and the bruised are all our people.

The meaning of bruised: in the Bible, bruises are often used metaphorically, a symbol, to represent the afflictions, trials and sufferings that we encounter in life. That we is our twelve tribes. White people try to use it for them; it ain’t talking about them, and that ain’t going to work. While a bruise may seem a temporary, insignificant mark on the body, its symbolic meaning goes much deeper. Bruises can be a reminder of the pain, like slavery and hardship, the oppressions we endure. White folk try to use the Bible for them; they’re using witchcraft. But bruises can also serve as a testimony of our resilience and faith.

This is an example of us being bruised, symbolism for the trials, tribulations and constant persecutions we go through. Timothy Coggins, back in 1983, was dragged on the back of a car with a chain wrapped around him, dragged until the bones showed. Jordan Davis: the white man said his music was too loud, and he was killed for playing loud music. Trayvon Martin, 2012, killed by George Zimmerman. Kendrick Johnson. Our people cry for justice and we get no justice. This is why the gospel is for our people.

And those images were not police brutality. The media likes to spin it and say it’s the police. It’s what that book said: caucasoid psychology, caucasoid behavior. All the crises of the world stem from one problem: white folks. A young man was hunted through the woods and killed, his head cut off, and they had the nerve to lie and say animals did that. White folks lie so much they even blame the animals. That’s their attitude towards us: you’re not organized, there’s no consequence, so they tell us anything they feel like and we just deal with it.
“And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.” They got so mad when he said that. He’s letting them know Isaiah was talking about him first and foremost.

precepts.why: To explain the poor: “What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.” The poor of his people are Zion. It’s not referring to all nations on the planet. The gospel is preached to the poor of our people.

This gives more insight into the poor of our people: “Blessed are the poor in spirit”. The picture of the brother sitting on the steps asking for help is an example of poor in spirit.

To be poor in spirit, you have lost your identity. You’ve lost your nationality, your culture, the laws of God in essence. That is our people.

Now the brokenhearted. “He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.” Who is he talking about? Verse 12: “Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.” So that’s the broken in heart.

Jump down to verses 19 and 20: “He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel. He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them.” This is more evidence that the brokenhearted is the Israelites. The brokenhearted is not the white man, the Chinese or the Arabs. It’s our people.

The picture of the young man crying on a brother’s shoulder is the brokenhearted. When our people are marching through the streets crying for justice, that’s the brokenhearted. And as a result we suffer from depression and anxiety, always wondering, am I next? Am I going to get killed next? This doesn’t happen to any other nation; it’s happening to our people and our people only.

“To preach deliverance to the captives.” They say everybody is the captives. That’s a lie; everybody ain’t the captives. “Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.” Where do we go, brothers? Captivity. We are the captives the gospel was meant to be preached to.

The captives: “And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.” We went into captivity and the Gentiles took our land. That’s what you see going on today.

“Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the Lord; neither be dismayed, O Israel”: neither be dismayed, neither be brokenhearted.

“For, lo, I will save thee from afar”. Afar is far away: he’s going to save us from far away places. So it’s not just here in America. This is why brothers must be dispatched, must be sent out to preach the glorious gospel. I can’t do it alone, brothers. Me, the bishops, the deacons, we can’t do it by ourselves. The captains, we need your help. Do you understand the mission? This is war.

“And thy seed from the land of their captivity”: there’s that word again, captivity. “And Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.” That’s the kingdom: the kingdom of heaven on earth.

“And recovering of sight to the blind”: our people are the blind. Verse 15 first: “But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee”.

One of the curses: “And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness”. We have physical eyes, but we are going to be spiritually blind, a spiritually blind people. “And thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.” No man shall save us.

Still on the blind. “Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us”: we are looking for justice, but the Bible says justice does not overtake us. “We wait for light, but behold obscurity”: confusion. Things that seem obvious in the world get obscured through the media. “For brightness, but we walk in darkness.”

“We grope for the wall like the blind”: like blind men, like blind women. “And we grope as if we had no eyes”: we walk in society as if we have no eyes. It’s talking about our spiritual eyes being closed; we are spiritually blind as a people. “We stumble at noonday as in the night”: that’s what Moses prophesied about. “We are in desolate places as dead men.”

“We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves”: we cry. That’s ‘no justice, no peace’. “We look for judgment, but there is none”: we look for true judgment, but there is none in this society. “For salvation, but it is far off from us.” Why? Because we don’t keep the commandments.

We act as if we had no eyes. What did Joe Biden do for us? We act like we don’t see that nothing was done for us. Mike Pence, nothing, and black people rallying behind them in political venues. ‘Let’s pray for Trump.’ We sit in church and pray in the name of Jesus. Now we’re looking for Kamala. That’s her family, her husband and kids: she ain’t thinking about you negroes. She is married to Amalek. Show me who you sleep with and I’ll show you who your allegiance is to. They’re trying to make her the black woman.

To explain bruised: “For thus saith the Lord, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.”

Jump down to verse 17: “For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the Lord”. God says that to us. “Because they called thee an Outcast”: they called us an outcast, the Gentiles, “saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.” A nation not desired: that’s what it’s saying.

When the Bible says ‘nation not desired’, it means we are not desired by any of them. That’s the bruised the gospel is sent to set at liberty.

A firefighter confessed that through the sixties and seventies it was very common for firefighters to leave black people and black children in burning houses and buildings and say they couldn’t get to them, and that he deliberately went in and did not save a baby he made eye contact with. They go to church. These are Christians.

“For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.” That’s them. They can’t get a good night’s sleep unless they hurt somebody, destroy some family, bomb a city, kill a baby.

He ain’t got to worry about forgiving himself. God ain’t forgiving him, and we ain’t forgiving him either. And notice he only blamed police, because that’s what the media has programmed black people to do. It’s more than just police. His speech is past tense; that’s how these Christians do. They leave everything in the past tense and act like they don’t see all the murders happening to us, the missing persons, the missing organs. They say they used to hate us and don’t hate us no more.

A lot of our people were not killed just by police. We got to stop blaming only the police. “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred”: it did not say just police officers, “and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end”. Even when we got emancipated, they kept it going.

Jump to the last verse, 15: “As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am the Lord.” The Christian says it doesn’t say the race. It gives the race it’s talking about: Idumea.

sense.text: Here is a prophecy, an example of the second angel’s message. “A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the Lord, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.” Now the thought may be with a Christian: this is talking about ancient Babylon.

“As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.” Babylon the great shall be destroyed; that’s what this whole thing is talking about.

Sodom and Gomorrah got overthrown by thermonuclear destruction, fire from heaven. That’s not how Nebuchadnezzar’s Babylon fell: Persia overthrew them and took their seat. And the modern name of ancient Babylon is Iraq. Do people live in Iraq today? Yes. So this Babylon ain’t talking about Iraq. You Christians out there, get your head out of white supremacy.

“Behold, a people shall come from the north”. Write this down: NATO. “And a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.” That’s NATO. Read it again and the many kings raised up are the Arabs and the Carmanians, the Iranians.

“They shall hold the bow and the lance”: they are going to have missile technology. “They are cruel, and will not shew mercy”: they ain’t going to show this place no mercy. “Their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.”

“The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.” When they see the nations joined together, America is going to get afraid.

“Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan”: America is going to come up like a lion, and the swelling of Jordan is the first month. “Unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her”.

Imagine it: the nations are coming against America. America sends all her military to go fight. The nations see it and fly back. So America thinks, they scared, we got them on the run. “And who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?”

“Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”: that’s Israel. Israel is going to draw them out. “Surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them”: they’re going to get destroyed.

America sends the military and the nations draw back. It looks like they’ve drawn back, but it’s a trap, a setup: the nations are sending parts of their military like a pincer, men on the flanks coming up behind.

“At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.” Everybody’s going to hear about the fall of Babylon. She thinks she’s so powerful. First she’s scared, then she sends her military, then ‘look, the nations are on the run, we got them’. But it’s a setup. God has the whole thing laid out here in the Bible.

precepts.why:
“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast”: the ten horns that come against Babylon, which is America. They “shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.”

The ten horns: Belgium, Luxembourg, and more besides, but there are going to be ten major ones that will be used to destroy the United States of America.

This is about the many kings that come with the people from the north: “And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.” The way of the kings of the east.

The precept that explains the kings of the east: “Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east”. From the east, “Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.” The dragons of Arabia: that’s the Arabs.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood”. The Carmanians is Iran. Everybody’s waiting for Iran to strike. Iran is not going to strike until the Arabs unite and make the first strike; then the Carmanians will follow. “And with great power shall they come, and join battle with them”: the Iranians are going to unite with the Arabs.

“And shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.” That’s modern day Israel, because ancient Assyria took over the northern kingdom.

To prove the daughter of Babylon is not Kush: “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom”. Edom, E-D-O-M: red people, the blood shows through their skin. That’s them. “In the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.”

“O daughter of Babylon”: that is what they call Edom. Edom is the daughter of Babylon, “who art to be destroyed”. That’s a prophecy. “Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.”

When does the Jordan swell? “These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks”. Jordan overflows his banks in the first month. So when he comes up “like a lion from the swelling of Jordan”, that’s the first month.

“These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.” The nations have one mind. Their power deals with the economic system, the finances, the World Bank, the International Monetary Fund: the EU deals with that. Their strength deals with their military, NATO, where all their militaries have a contract to support one another. So their power and strength is their money system and their military, and they support America for the time being.

“Come out of her, my people”: we got to come out of the Babylon the great mentality, this Babylonian state of mind, “that ye be not partakers of her sins”. Don’t be partakers in Christmas, Thanksgiving, the 4th of July, New Year’s Eve, Mother’s Day, all that foolishness; the LGBT community, pronouns: come out of her. “And that ye receive not of her plagues.” “For her sins have reached unto heaven”: the sins of this country have reached unto heaven. “And God hath remembered her iniquities.”

“Reward her even as she rewarded you”: reward America even as she rewarded you. That’s called vengeance. “And double unto her double according to her works”: the Bible says give her double. Ain’t going to be no mercy. God says give America double what she did to us. “In the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.”

“How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously”: how much America has glorified herself and lived deliciously on the earth, “so much torment and sorrow give her”. This is the Bible. “For she saith in her heart, I sit a queen”: the Statue of Liberty, “and am no widow”: I will never lose my allies, “and shall see no sorrow.”

“Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.” This is God’s judgment, not our judgment.

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her”, the kings that did business with her, “shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning, Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come. And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more”. That’s their buying and selling.

Write this down: the one in Revelation 17 is Babylon in chapter 18.

sense.text: These are precepts for the third angel and the mark. “Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come”: the second coming of Christ shall not come, “except there come a falling away first”: except the Israelites fall into captivity. “And that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition”.

“Who opposeth”: you can’t just run by them words. He opposes everything God says. “And exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God”: he sets himself up as God, and he sets his churches up as the churches of God, “shewing himself that he is God.” This is talking about the white man. You can’t get nobody else out of that.

“Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”: this man our people adore. Everything he does is based upon satanic influence. Even food stamps: there is a satanic reason behind food stamps, to break up our families. And you thought he was being loving and kind. So was the school system: it was meant for them to indoctrinate our children. Eight hours a day, five days a week, our children spend more time with them than with us, and they send you to jail if you don’t send your kids to their schools. If you examine everything in this system, there is a satanic influence behind it.

“With all power and signs and lying wonders”.

“And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish”: that means going against God’s commandments. The deceivableness of unrighteousness is breaking the commandments. Revelation doesn’t use those words, but Thessalonians and Revelation are talking about the same thing.

“Because they received not the love of the truth”: because our people receive not the love of God’s truth, the everlasting gospel, “that they might be saved.”
“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie”: God allows Satan’s influence to work on them.

“That they all might be damned”: all our people who are rebellious, “who believed not the truth”: they believe not the everlasting gospel, “but had pleasure in unrighteousness.” That pleasure in unrighteousness is the mark. It’s not a microchip. It is having pleasure in sin, breaking God’s commandments. Whether it’s a chip or a digital thing, that’s how they try to enforce their idolatrous practices.

They want to merge the religions as one and bring about coexistence. If you cannot coexist and not speak against it, there’s going to be penalties to pay: you will not be able to buy or sell in this system. Vatican News reported Pope Francis, at the seventh congress of leaders of world and traditional religions in Kazakhstan, urging all religions and societies to involve women and young people in the quest for world peace. They want all religions to come together, and the women and young people included. That was a couple of years ago, but they plan long term; they don’t plan like black people. There are about 4,200 religions worldwide, and their agenda is to bring everything together.

precepts.why:
“For we wrestle not against flesh and blood”. Our people think if we vote for somebody else, this other person is going to do right by us. No. “But against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world”: the rulers of the governments of this world, “against spiritual wickedness in high places.”

Take this man and move him out the way: whoever sits in that seat is under satanic influence. That’s why Obama couldn’t do nothing, and that’s why Kamala can’t either.
“And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.” That’s what we’re going to see as they bring all the religions together.

“Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits”. We just went over seducing spirits: the coexistence of all religions. They haven’t implemented it yet, but it is coming. “And doctrines of devils.”

“And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.” Brothers, we got to realize the whole world lieth in wickedness.

“And we know that the Son of God is come”: Christ has come, “and hath given us an understanding”. That’s what the Holy Spirit is all about: giving us an understanding, “that we may know him that is true”, the one true God, “and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.”

“Little children, keep yourselves from idols.” We got to keep ourselves from the idolatrous religions that are out there.
